Title: Apply Phase 0 foundation pack through a reviewed PR
Definition of Done: PR merged; six-member roster, DVWA, Docker Compose and XMind links recorded

Title: Deploy DVWA using official Docker Compose
Definition of Done: docker compose ps captured; local page loads; Git commit recorded

Title: Verify DVWA is loopback-only
Definition of Done: compose.yml shows 127.0.0.1 binding; no LAN/Internet exposure

Title: Capture practical implementation evidence
Definition of Done: Browser screenshot, docker ps, version and commit evidence linked

Title: Assign six team members to workstreams
Definition of Done: Each member has an owner role, reviewer, and visible output

Title: Create GitHub Issues and Project board
Definition of Done: Tasks have status, priority, owner, reviewer and due date

Title: Confirm Architecture submission format and acceptance with instructor
Definition of Done: Expected format, implemented-part evidence and revised due date recorded

Title: Review DVWA API lab prerequisites and coverage gaps
Definition of Done: mod_rewrite/vendor prerequisites checked; any gaps and supplemental lab request recorded

Title: Confirm Sondos full name and GitHub username; add repository access
Expected Output: Updated team roster and collaborator access
Definition of Done: Sondos identity confirmed by team and invited by repository admin

Title: Study HTTP/HTTPS, methods, headers, cookies, sessions and auth flows
Definition of Done: Notes reviewed by another member

Title: Configure Burp Suite Proxy, Repeater, Intruder and site map
Definition of Done: Approved lab traffic passes through proxy; raw Burp project kept outside Git

Title: Create actual DVWA application map
Definition of Done: Map is based on observed app pages/modules, not just the XMind planning map

Title: Build request/response inventory
Definition of Done: Observed requests include method, path, role/context and evidence IDs; secrets redacted

Title: Document authentication/session flow
Definition of Done: Login, session, logout and relevant state captured from actual application

Title: Prepare and review the security test plan
Definition of Done: Tests mapped to DEPI requirements, target capability and approved scope

Title: Test SQL injection (SQLi)
Definition of Done: Test executed per docs/METHODOLOGY.md; payload and result recorded with sanitized evidence IDs; outcome status assigned

Title: Test cross-site scripting (XSS: reflected/stored/DOM as supported by the running target)
Definition of Done: Each supported XSS variant tested and validated; unsupported variants marked Not applicable with a gap note

Title: Test cross-site request forgery (CSRF)
Definition of Done: Test executed and validated; applicability against the running target confirmed or marked Not applicable

Title: Test server-side request forgery (SSRF)
Definition of Done: Applicability assessed first; if the target does not support SSRF testing record Not applicable and document the gap for instructor follow-up

Title: Test insecure file upload
Definition of Done: Test executed and validated; destructive upload behavior kept inside approved lab conditions per Rules of Engagement

Title: Test path traversal
Definition of Done: Test executed and validated; no bulk extraction beyond what a specific finding requires

Title: Test local/remote file inclusion (LFI/RFI)
Definition of Done: LFI tested; RFI applicability depends on target configuration — assess and record result honestly

Title: Document PoCs for validated Week 2 findings
Definition of Done: PoC written for Confirmed findings only; quality gate in docs/METHODOLOGY.md satisfied; reviewer approved

Title: Compile Week 2 payload list
Definition of Done: Payloads used across Week 2 tests recorded with test IDs; no real credentials included

Title: Compile Week 2 evidence and screenshots
Definition of Done: Evidence sanitized per evidence/README.md; stored under evidence/sanitized/ with proper IDs

Title: Perform CVSS assessment for validated Week 2 findings
Definition of Done: Score proposed by tester and confirmed during independent review; reasoning recorded

Title: Write remediation notes for Week 2 findings
Definition of Done: Concrete fix described per Confirmed finding; feeds Week 4 remediation plan

Title: Assess JWT weaknesses
Definition of Done: Applicability against the running target assessed first; if no JWT surface exists record Not applicable with gap note

Title: Test session hijacking and fixation
Definition of Done: Tests use synthetic lab accounts only; secrets redacted from all evidence

Title: Test IDOR/BOLA access control weaknesses
Definition of Done: Access-control tests executed between authorized synthetic roles; minimal data accessed per finding

Title: Test broken authentication
Definition of Done: Test executed and validated per docs/METHODOLOGY.md

Title: Assess excessive data exposure
Definition of Done: Responses reviewed for unnecessary sensitive data; no bulk extraction performed

Title: Test rate limiting / brute-force protection
Definition of Done: Low-and-slow approach only; no denial-of-service or stress testing

Title: Test business logic flaws
Definition of Done: Logic-based tests documented honestly; inconclusive results left Inconclusive

Title: Intercept and analyze API requests (after P0-08 prerequisite check)
Definition of Done: Depends on P0-08: API lab prerequisites verified; if unsupported record Not applicable and request instructor-approved supplemental lab

Title: Build the API test collection
Definition of Done: Collection built only for API surface actually verified as available; no invented endpoints

Title: Document API findings
Definition of Done: Findings limited to validated results; coverage gaps explicitly stated

Title: Chain validated findings into attack chains
Definition of Done: Chains use only Confirmed findings; each link traceable to evidence IDs

Title: Write the final Web/API penetration test report
Definition of Done: Report claims limited to validated results; coverage limitations stated; independent full review completed

Title: Retest findings after fixes or configuration changes
Definition of Done: Original procedure rerun with new evidence IDs; statuses per docs/METHODOLOGY.md vocabulary

Title: Create the attack chain diagram
Definition of Done: Diagram reflects only evidence-supported chains

Title: Write the remediation plan
Definition of Done: Consolidates remediation notes from Weeks 2-3; prioritized by severity

Title: Write the executive summary
Definition of Done: Non-technical summary consistent with the final report; no unvalidated claims

Title: Prepare demo video/screenshots
Definition of Done: All materials sanitized per evidence/README.md; no secrets or personal data
